name: smixs-code-quality
description: Deterministic code quality gate for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, pi): git hooks that block test tampering, hold the CRAP bar on changed functions, check diff coverage, secrets and dependencies. 12 languages, one config file. Optional Jev classifier for test hunks.
